chapters.title: Second Tablet — verified source excerpt, not an edition
paragraphs: And when he had sated himself with her charms, he turned his countenance toward his cattle. The gazelles, resting, beheld Eabani; they and the cattle of the field turned away from him. This startled Eabani and his body grew faint; his knees became stiff, as his cattle departed, and he became less agile than ever before.
